rationale: The project has genuinely distinct subsystems: build config, routing/layout, reusable UI primitives, the SVG diagram, and 14 pages of content. Each can be developed and tested independently with clean interfaces. Total LOC will exceed 500 across all pages.

decision: Content hardcoded in TSX, not parsed from markdown
rationale: Per interview answers and the 'accuracy is paramount' requirement, all howto.md content is hardcoded into TypeScript data structures and JSX rather than using a markdown parser or Vite plugin.

decision: Pipeline diagram as separate component from shared_ui
rationale: The SVG pipeline diagram is a complex, one-off component with routing dependencies and its own interaction logic — it doesn't belong in the generic shared UI library.

decision: Single StepPage template component with per-step data
rationale: All 13 step pages share the same layout (commands, gotchas, warnings, tips, video, version badge). A generic StepPage component receives typed step data, avoiding 13 copies of layout code. Thin wrapper components per step pass the correct data slice.
Per assumptions, Tailwind v3 is used for stability. Standard postcss.config.js + tailwind.config.js setup with content paths pointing to src/**/*.tsx.
Modern browsers support navigator.clipboard.writeText. No polyfill needed for a developer-facing documentation site. Button shows visual feedback on copy.
